name: gizza-ai/remove-empty-lines
summary: Delete blank or whitespace-only lines, compacting text

tool.description: Remove empty lines from text, compacting it. mode=remove (default) deletes every blank line; mode=collapse reduces runs of 2+ consecutive blank lines to a single blank line. whitespace_only=true (default) also deletes lines that contain only spaces/tabs; trim_lines=true trims leading/trailing whitespace from each kept line. Returns the compacted text plus total/removed/kept line counts. Runs locally.

mode.description: remove = delete every empty line (no gaps); collapse = reduce runs of 2+ consecutive empty lines to a single blank line (keeps paragraph spacing). Default remove.

text.description: The text to compact. Blank and (by default) whitespace-only lines are deleted.

trim_lines.description: Trim leading and trailing whitespace from each kept line. Default false.

whitespace_only.description: Also treat lines containing only spaces/tabs (or any whitespace) as empty, not just literally-empty lines. Default true.
